answer: A newcomer votes only after three sponsors, each with 50 attested epochs, sign its admission with their quill and lock 50 timber behind it. The ledge refuses any quill that signed an admission in the last 100 epochs and burns a sponsor's timber if its newcomer is later proven a clone. An honest newcomer asks three acquaintances. An operator fielding 20 clones must recruit 60 unrelated veterans and bribe each past a 50-timber risk, and because his clones have no tenure they cannot vouch for each other.
